skill.description: Extract text and structure from PDFs and scans using OCR and document parsers.

memory.responsibility: Retain pdf or scanned images plus decisions, observations, and verification evidence needed to resume safely.

planning.responsibility: Transform page rasterizer into the ordered, bounded stages defined by this skill.

action.responsibility: Advance the workflow through ocr and layout detector while preserving stop conditions and user authority.

capability.responsibility: Expose the minimum service operations required for the requested target; writes require an explicit preview gate.

stages: Inspect file type page count and quality
Detect text blocks tables and reading order
Export searchable text with page references

maturity.claim_boundary: This repository validates and plans the harness contract; it does not claim live service execution or benchmark gains without a connected adapter and measured evidence.
